findings.claim: C13's profile prerequisite gates omit C18 even though the operational matrix requires C18 before the home/personal-cloud mode can be advertised.
findings.evidence: C13 states: "personal peer or home/cloud context requires C12" and work_packages.profileDependencies lists "personal-peer-home-cloud": ["C04", "C06", "C12"]. But operational_modes says "KnowMe phone + home or personal cloud ... Slices | C12–C13, C18". This contradiction lets downstream accept or advertise a remote home/cloud profile without the federated compatibility/release evidence gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep C13 as an implementation prerequisite for C18, but add an explicit release/advertising gate that home/personal-cloud profiles are not supported until C18 passes for that mode; update C13 profileDependencies or add a separate releaseDependencies field including C18.

findings.claim: C15 mandates routing through an unevaluated dependency named `liter-llm` that is absent from the candidate list and external dependency gates.
findings.evidence: C15.1 says: "extend task-guided role selection and model strength/cost/capability routing through liter-llm with exact selected model recorded." The library_candidates for C15 only list cand-005 "Merged agent-team skills and Agent Skills format" as adopt; no candidate evaluates `liter-llm` or a similarly named model router, and C15 external checkpoints are only D-MINI, D-KNOWME, D-FORGE.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the specific `liter-llm` mandate and describe an existing reviewed model-routing interface, or add a candidate/evaluation and checkpoint for the exact library/tool, including maintenance/version verification and whether the name is intended to be LiteLLM.
